Paying monthly for no Premium updates in 5 mo?. I'm have been a Premium user for a long time--I love the functionality in this app. Creating morning and evening routines with timers for each task, nagging reminders, and additional routines are fantastic and something I haven't been able to find in other apps.

However, I can't justify paying monthly for an app that hasn't been updated in 5 months. To me, the value of a monthly app payment is when there are regular updates (as in both new/enhanced features and maintenance/bug fixes). If not, why a monthly subscription model? I would be comfortable if there was one flat fee to to unlock premium features for a static/inactive app.

Hopefully the developer is still working on this app, but I know this is a niche app category and the paying user base size might not be big enough to support it.

I've cancelled my renewing subscription. If the developer actively develops again, or makes the existing premium features available for a flat fee, I'd pay again. 

FYI there is one bug: I never use the calendar sync, but every time I change the number of sleep hours or the time I leave for work, the calendar sync automatically turns back on again. I have to manually turn it off every time.

New features I’d love to see:

1) Integrate additional routines into the main week screen where morning and evening routines are.

2) Ability to modify the routine completion message (maybe also per routine). Right now it’s in bold caps with multiple exclamations: “CONGRATS! ROUTINE FINISHED!!!” It feels like it’s just screaming at me with overzealous excitement. Instead I want to feel a sense of joyful accomplishment and inner peace. If I could change this, it would read something like “Well done! You’ve finished your routine.”

3) Completion message as an in-app screen instead of iOS notification. I always have to dismiss the notification from my phone, which I find silly because I’m sitting in the app when I check off the last item the notifications make more sense for the “nag me” feature when I might not be looking at the app or it’s closed. I like how Calm does their completion screen. After finishing a session, a screen shows with “Nice work! Your current streak is X days” along with some other details and next actions. It would be cool to see the routine completion streak or maybe a snippet of the report on a completion screen as reinforcement and encouragement.

4) Ability to see stats and history for individual tasks as well as additional routines (not just Morning and Evening). I sometimes skip steps in my routines, and it shows whether I completed everything in a finished routine or just some which is great, but I want to dial down more and see which individual steps I’ve skipped and how frequently. It gives me the insight I like to see in a traditional habit tracker. I like to see my streak for things like doing the dishes or flossing. This would make the app even more valuable because I wouldn’t have to track this info in a different app!

Fantastic for AM/PM with Potential for Full Functionality. First: The way the app starts with counting back from your AM leave time to the start of your bedtime routine is brilliant. It takes some struggling to figure out how it works. I’d strongly suggest a short video to walk users through all the steps & features, as the intro is vague. I just figured out I can skip an item! Who knows what other hidden features I’m missing. The help button is good but not quite enough. 

Second: I happily paid for the upgrade because the other routines were my primary need. Being able to create routines for transitioning to work, transitioning to homeschooling my son, transitioning to dinner/family time, and then back to work at my home office was what sent me looking for this app in the first place. The morning/night routines were just a happy bonus find. 

Sadly, the additional routines are not kept on the dashboard & the stats aren’t recorded. For now I’m screenshotting (sp?) the daily results then putting the details in other time trackers & logs. But I might end up moving back to an app like toggl for these routines. We’ll see if the current system works for my easily sidetracked brain. I understand the amount of work that goes into building an indie app & want to support that if I can. 

Also, I disabled the calendar integration as it still gives you multiple entries, but that’s ok as I wanted to use this to get routines OFF my calendar anyway. 

So for now, I’d say get the app for sure. Upgrade if tracking other routines isn’t important to you and if you don’t mind the extra work of hunting them down & resetting them daily. 

If you have ADHD & suffer from time blindness, this app is invaluable for taking the stress out of your mornings!

I get SO MUCH MORE DONE with this app!. This is going to be long but when I say this app changed my life...bro. 
I’ve been looking for a routine schedule app for so long and have tried countless apps out there. They were good, but not what I was looking for. THIS ONE is better than I ever thought I needed! This one has the potential to actually stick and not just stop using after a few weeks because you literally get SO MUCH done with it. 

It literally keeps you on track instead of just alerting you when your next task is scheduled like other apps. It works backwards to tell you what time you need to go to bed and wake up to get your routine done by the time you need to be out the door in the morning. Nothing has been this kind of a life saver. 

I used to think I didn’t have time for so many things, but with this app I’ve realized that I can do so much more with my time. I get so much more done each day now, and am feeling so much better and more confident about myself. It’s really insane. 

If you are not good at getting things done/staying on track and are prone to distractions, THIS IS FOR YOU! 
And you get so many free items to start out with while you learn the app/get used to it, much more than other apps give you. 
It’s definitely a little harder to get used to than other simpler apps but the tutorial is super hands-on and involved so I was able to get the hang of it by the second day. 

Suggestions: I do wish that the extra routines that you can add were just as customizable as the morning and evening ones. For instance, I would like to add chores that I do once a week to my chores routine, but can’t change the day of the single chore, only the whole list. I also wish I could get insights on those extra routines as well to see how well I’m keeping up with those. Other than that, amazing. Thank you so much for making this app! -Like others I'd like some kind of chime/alert saying you're off schedule
-If the previous suggestion happens then after your routine is finished it needs to stay finished, now the only option is to click "clear checkmarks". I find this a little stressful seeing the timers start again.
-I work a night job and I'm rarely in bed by midnight-there seems to be a 12-hour clock issue that tries to put me to bed around noon. I did a bit of a workaround but now it prompts my night routine a little earlier than I'd like.
